release_notes: Refined DVNM Bot faceplate coverage and circular lens alignment to hide the source illustration’s crescent eye artwork.
Moved the existing DVNM chest aura to the chest insignia and increased its speaking-state intensity.
Kept the floating assistant panel fixed to the viewport and independent of the launcher width; added mobile-safe touch/scroll behavior and a high stacking level.
Extended a brighter luminous midnight palette to every demo page surface, forms, product cards, sample events, filters and footers.
Updated bot CSS/cutout versions and service-worker cache marker to v26.
Existing art is retained; original outward-arm pose is unchanged. No generated or replacement robot art was used.
DVNM Bot assistant panel width fixed independently of its narrow floating launcher, with viewport-safe positioning and pointer-enabled controls.
Added a glass visor overlay and normal circular lens-eye animation to mask the original curved eye marks.
Enhanced the speaking chest aura and enabled visual speech state on the floating robot.
Refined the dark theme into an illuminated midnight-violet palette with clearer panels and gentler transitions.

v24 replaces the hand-built CSS floating robot with the existing full-body DVNM art as a transparent cutout; the launcher and homepage/welcome/assistant robot wrappers no longer show an image-frame rectangle.

DVNM Bot v22 adds responsive open-eye overlays with natural blinking, subtle gaze motion, and a mouth animation that opens/closes while speech is active; updated the homepage, welcome panel, assistant panel, bot guide, and service-worker cache version.
Static route compatibility repair: explicit .html links, legacy clean-URL redirects, and service-worker offline recovery for failed navigation.
Demo Studio expanded to seven original sample website demonstrations, including Davonium technology and community/event experiences.
Website QR code moved immediately below the homepage hero.
DVNM Bot speech cancellation/start flow revised for more reliable mobile browser speech and default-voice fallback.
Robot visual styling upgraded with glowing optical lenses, chest core, antenna beacon, and hologram floor.
Responsive CSS hardening added for phone, tablet, laptop, landscape and short-height layouts.
New mobile-first quality and speech/accessibility guides added; sitemap and service-worker cache updated.
DVNM Bot now speaks line-by-line in shorter browser utterances with default-voice fallback to improve resilience on mobile speech engines.
notes: Sample website demonstration showcase record is explicitly non-official and non-accredited.
All sample forms, RSVP actions, and shop interactions are demo-only.
Browser-native speech is device-dependent; text remains available, and the speech queue uses short line-sized utterances with a default-device voice fallback.
voiceControls: installed device voice selection in welcome and bot panel
sentence-sized speech utterance queue for mobile resilience
fallback to device default voice if the selected voice fails
samplePresentation: Davonium-created sample website demonstrations; not claimed client deployments.
